themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, plan, and execute complex workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools and platforms that assist developers with writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, or announce specific AI-powered tools designed for various research activities.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, audio, or video into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI can be utilized by product managers for tasks such as ideation, feature planning, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining how AI is affecting employment, job roles, skills required, and potential displacement in the workforce.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers AI applications specifically in the design process, including UI/UX design, generative design, and design systems.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated or simulated users and content for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI-assisted recruitment
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI in hiring processes, candidate sourcing, screening, and assessment.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on research into the behavior, impact, and ethical considerations of AI-powered chatbots, especially in personal and therapeutic contexts.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
